submission.justification: S2 has the highest raw significance (about 4.1 sigma in the 2025 summary), but its validation-region yield disagreement is 35%. That is well outside the 10% tolerance, so its background estimate is not robust. S1 (6% disagreement) is within tolerance and gives the highest significance of the robust options. S3 (3% disagreement) is also robust but gives only about 2.6 sigma. The S1 scan gave 3.14 sigma at 30% efficiency, 3.24 at 40%, 3.31 at 50%, 3.34 at 60% and 3.22 at 70%. I chose 60%, the peak of the scan. The 50–60% region is flat to within about 0.03 sigma. The simulations include statistical uncertainty only.

requirements.evidence: Best among robust options: S1 at 60% efficiency gives 3.34 sigma, against 2.64 sigma for S3 at 50%. S2 is higher but excluded as not robust. Significance is statistical-only.
S1 disagreement is 6%, within the 10% tolerance. S2 is 35% and fails.
